text:
sam (marketing): Heads up — embargo window shifted: new embargo is 2026-04-02 16:00 PT (was 12:00). Please HOLD all social and syndication until I give the GO. Notion brief: https://notion.redwood/example-ops (internal). cc @jules @anya

jules (PR): Copy. Are we still releasing the benchmark blog and the product blog together at that time?

sam (marketing): Yes — blog + benchmark post go simultaneous. We want press + social to be aligned. Sam to hit GO at 16:00 PT.

riya (ops): On it — I'll pause scheduled posts. Need final hero image + canonical URL to requeue. Who's uploading the image?

anya (comms): Legal flagged a small tweak to the CEO quote. Current: "predictable inference performance" -> proposed: "predictable, cost-efficient inference performance". Legal asked for explicit sign-off from Kevin.

legal-bot: Legal review complete (1937654335): approved language change to CEO quote. No further edits required.

kevin (ceo): I sign off on the tweaked quote. Good to go from my side.

jules (PR): Drafting email to top-tier outlets. Proposed one-liner for pitch: "Redwood Inference launches Optimize to cut token-unit costs while preserving latency SLOs." Thoughts?

sam (marketing): That works — trim to one sentence in the subject line. Also include the benchmark highlight table and a small reproducibility note.

press-bot: Press list queued (50 contacts). Outreach is in HOLD state awaiting manual "GO" from sam.

riya (ops): Scheduling note for syndication windows: US push at 16:05 PT, EU at 00:05 CET, APAC at 08:05 SGT. I'll align CDN invalidation + social posts.

jules (PR): I'll prepare two follow-up angles (technical deep dive, and product impact) to ping journalists after the embargo lifts.

sam (marketing): Final checklist for GO (will tick at 16:00 PT): 1) blog live and canonical URL 2) benchmark table + methods uploaded 3) hero image uploaded to CDN 4) CEO quote updated 5) press release uploaded to Drive (link in notion) 6) social threads drafted 7) press list confirmed 8) legal greenlight (done)

riya (ops): Confirmed: CDN image uploaded (1937654352), caching TTL set to 60s for immediate proxy refresh.

sam (marketing): OK — standing by. I'll post GO here at 16:00 PT and ping the channel + @press-bot. Please do not outreach or publish until then. :rocket:

jules (PR): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby for follow-ups to top-tier outlets.

kevin (ceo): Thanks everyone. Quick ask: if any outlet requests embargo exceptions, direct them to PR; we will evaluate case-by-case.

sam (marketing): Noted. No exceptions unless it's a top-four outlet and I confirm. Last note: if anything breaks at publish, post in #release-war-room and ping eng-oncall.

sam (marketing): (final) GO will be posted here at 1937654400 if all still green. Standby.
